name: cap-raycast
title: Cap Screen Recorder
description: Start and stop Cap recordings and open your Cap web dashboard directly from Raycast.
author: capsoftware

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Recording Mode
preferences.description: Recording mode used when starting a recording from Raycast.

preferences.name: defaultScreen
preferences.title: Default Screen Name
preferences.description: Display name of the target screen to capture.

preferences.name: captureSystemAudio
preferences.title: Capture System Audio
preferences.description: Include system audio when starting a recording.
preferences.label: Capture system audio by default

preferences.name: copyUrlOnStop
preferences.title: Copy Video URL on Stop
preferences.description: Copy the shareable Cap video URL to the clipboard when stopping a recording.
preferences.label: Copy shareable URL automatically

preferences.name: dashboardUrl
preferences.title: Cap Dashboard URL
preferences.description: URL of your Cap web dashboard (supports Cap Cloud and self-hosted instances).

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.description: Start a Cap recording using your configured default settings.

commands.name: stop-recording
commands.title: Stop Recording
commands.description: Stop the active Cap recording and copy the video URL to your clipboard.

commands.name: open-dashboard
commands.title: Open Web Dashboard
commands.description: Open the Cap web dashboard in your default browser.
